roleAssign.footnote: Assignment is idempotent: the same (user, role, scope) triple returns the same record. Revocation is a soft delete, so the same triple can be assigned again. Built-in roles have a fixed permission set — create a custom role if you need a different combination.

roleAssign.hostHint: Applies on that host only — and the role's global permissions are ignored here. Otherwise "assign admin on one host" would be a silent system-wide promotion.
roleAssign.model: Authorization is a (user, role, scope) triple: one host can hold several roles at once and the effective permissions are their union.
